blurb: Frenchman Bay Conservancy manages several nature preserves with hiking trails and paddling access. At Day Ridges Preserve, guests can hike nature trails or borrow a canoe to paddle on Lower West Bay Pond. The canoe loan program requires contacting the Stewardship Manager to arrange pickup of canoe key, paddles, and lifejackets.
